description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, activate two basic Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Gauntlet of Power triggers twice, adding {U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two basic Islands to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two basic Islands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite {U}, you may instead use any other lands you control to get infinite mana those lands produce.
